quote: Metrics. When testing, TEMP ranks all candidate taxonomy-paths for each test concept. ... We use these metrics: (1) Accuracy (Acc) ... (2) Mean reciprocal rank (MRR) ... (3) Wu & Palmer similarity (Wu&P) ...
We use Accuracy (Acc), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Wu & Palmer similarity (Wu&P) as metrics to evaluate the taxonomy expansion.

Following previous works , we use these metrics: (1) Accuracy (Acc) measures the counting of the exactly predicted taxonomy-path. (2) Mean reciprocal rank (MRR) calculates the average of reciprocal ranks of the true taxonomy-path. (3) Wu & Palmer similarity (Wu&P) measures the semantic similarity between the predicted taxonomy-path and the truth taxonomy-path
